race.comment: SWIFT DELIVERY (7) is the top pick despite a plain debut at Kembla Grange, where she was beaten over 12 lengths after fading late. Strengthened over the break with the two solid trials. Blinkers come off and maps well. Leading contender. TITAN OF FURY (11) has the strongest recent race finish, closing hard for third at Quirindi when beaten half a length, though he now comes from country grade into harder company and still has a long maiden record. Will be strong late. PROPANE (10) resumes after six months, brings a close third in a Hawkesbury trial, has placed at this distance and has a first-time visor to sharpen him. Genuine each way contender. CALIPPO (5) improved first-up at this track after early interference, and the draw with Tyler Schiller going on gives him a genuine chance to take another step. Back in trip and looks to find a weaker race.
